title: You Can Always Reply Here (Clean Close)
style: warm acoustic jazz-folk, fingerpicked guitar, soft clarinet, gentle female lead vocal, brushed drums, upright bass, 84 BPM, peaceful resolution, the rare clean exit
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You can always reply here
If anything else comes up
The bot signed off polite and clear
The rare clean closing cup

[Pre-Chorus]
No loop, no scripted reload
No angry escalation mode

[Chorus]
You can always reply here
If anything else comes up
Your conversation has ended
Drop files or images, fill the cup
You can always reply here
The door's not locked behind
Fin AI signing off clean
The rare and clear-eyed kind

[Verse 2]
January refund processed
Five to ten and funds confessed
Quality of responses didn't meet
My needs — honest answer, complete

[Bridge]
The thread that worked is the thread that closed
No fight, no loop, no scripted prose
The bot did the job and stepped away
A template for every other day

[Final Chorus]
You can always reply here
If anything else comes up
Drop files or images here
They'll be added to your conversation cup
You can always reply here
The model the bots should learn
Click yes, get the refund
Close the door — don't churn
